## 4.2.3 The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.
System shall return availability status indicating whether item is available or unavailable for requested period
Availability queries shall reflect latest rent and item status information at query time
System shall allow users to query item availability for a specified date range
System shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur
System shall allow authorized users to define availability restrictions for items
System shall allow authorized users to define maintenance periods for items
Availability status shall reflect current lifecycle state of rent records
System shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records
System shall mark items as unavailable during maintenance periods
System shall prevent rent creation during maintenance periods
Availability changes shall be applied immediately
exceptions: Maintenance periods and availability restrictions use existing non-rentable status handling but may require UI distinction from other forms of temporary unavailability
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier implementation discussion suggested using single fallback delay after rental events, but current availability rules do not rely on uniform timing assumptions
